hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; f="${f#$ROOT/}"; case "$f" in *.php) cd "$ROOT"; OUT=$(./vendor/bin/sail pint --test 2>&1); CODE=$?; if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg reason "$OUT" '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'; fi ;; esac; }
